text:
Morgan: fyi nightly kbench flagged a perf regression on candidate kernel picks for seq=2048 (H100, ampere build). saw a ~18% p99 tail increase when kv-cache is hot. attaching raw micro output below.

Raja: ugh. is this on the new fused-attn path or the fallback matmul?

Morgan: looks like fused path for mid/long seq. CI log: 
```
kbench: run=kv_profile seq=2048 kernel=0x8f sample=200
median=3.2ms -> 3.8ms (+18.7%)
p99=7.9ms -> 9.4ms (+19.0%)
kv-cache-hit-rate=0.83 csv: batch=4
```

Priya: hmm kv-cache hit-rate 0.83 is realistic. could be batching heuristics changed effective batch sizes? did autotuner pick different tile sizes?

Morgan: autotune picked v2_merged_tile for this candidate. previous stable used v1_tilepack. autotune logs show a tie-breaker on throughput w/ latency margin allowed.

Nate: can you repro locally with trace + nvprof? if it's kernel-level divergence we should see extra synchronization or bad launch config.

Morgan: yes repro command i used: 
```
./tools/kbench --model vicuna-13b --device h100 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --kernel-candidate v2_merged_tile --iters 300 --kv-cache on --trace kernel
```
trace shows extra global memcpy at step ~110 that wasn't present on v1.

Priya: that suggests a fallback path inside kv cache management. maybe we introduced an extra copy for hot cache eviction in merged tile layout. i'll grep the runtime for any memcpy added in the last autotune commit.

Raja: for CI quick fix we should gate this candidate from nightly sweep until triage completes. ci-bot: can you pin nightly to use stable kernel set for next run? @ci-bot

ci-bot: scheduled nightly-run with pinned-kernels=stable at 2026-11-14T06:00Z. rollback tag applied: kernel-set=stable-20261113.

Nate: logging idea: add a lightweight kv-cache probe header in kbench output that prints cache ops per-step and whether we took memcpy fallback. that'll make triage faster for future sweeps.

Priya: agreed. i'll add a small signal: `KV_DBG: evict_copy=yes/none` in microbench. also will run a bisect across tile variants to find offending commit.

Morgan: thanks. action items:
- Priya: grep runtime changes & add KV_DBG probe, run bisect (ETA today)
- Nate: run nvprof capture and look for unexpected kernels / memcpys (ETA 4h)
- Raja: update perf CI gating to skip candidate in nightly sweep (done)
- Morgan: collect flamegraph + commit range and post results here

Priya: starting grep now. initial hit: runtime/kv/cache_manager.cpp line ~312 a new `memcpy_async` was added in autotune branch. sending patch reference.

Nate: nvprof shows a cudaMemcpyAsync at ~120us per step when seq>1024 only with v2_merged_tile. that matches. looks like we accidentally introduced a copy for alignment in that kernel.

Morgan: nice find. can we avoid copy by adjusting kernel launch to handle unaligned tails? or add a fastpath for hot cache case?

Priya: i'll try removing the memcpy and instead adjust the tile strides logic. quick local run shows median back to 3.25ms and p99 8.0ms. will open PR with test + benchmark.

Raja: when PR is ready we should run a targeted nightly mini-sweep for seq 512/1024/2048 across H100/ampere to validate no regressions for other seq lengths. CI team: please schedule after merge.

ci-bot: PR 4389 created by Priya: "fix: avoid memcpy in kv cache for v2_merged_tile". mini-sweep scheduled upon merge.

Morgan: awesome. thanks everyone. let's keep candidate gating until mini-sweep passes. will update this thread with the sweep results. :thumbsup:

Priya: posting benchmark logs in artifacts: link: https://artifacts.redwood/kbench/2917308000/patch-4389

Nate: verified with nvprof attached. no extra memcpy events. p99 back to baseline.

Morgan: closing loop: once mini-sweep (H100/ampere) passes we unpin nightly and let autotune candidates flow again.

Raja: note for postmortem: autotuner tie-breaker should consider 'kv-cache memcpy penalty' signal in microbench to avoid picks that force copies. adding to roadmap.

ci-bot: nightly-run unpinned after sweep pass on 2026-11-15T07:22Z.
